scope: Proposition 6.2 (Finite staggered yield) of the manuscript “Staggered extraction for exact matrix multiplication over every field” (preprints/Staggered-extraction-for-exact-matrix-multiplication-over-every-field-September-24-2026/Staggered-extraction-for-exact-matrix-multiplication-over-every-field-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 107 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 85aa655473a156ad), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume the prescriptions of Section 5, the balance conditions (38), and positive entries of LA, LB, LC. Let S∗ = S0 + S1 + S2 be the terminal rate defined above. For every fixed integer K ≥ 2 and every ϵ > 0, suitable fixed rational approximations, part allocations, and tolerances give, for all sufficiently large divisible N, a restriction of exp(oK(N)) copies of CW⊗8KN 5 to sN identical matrix tensors of volume VN , where log sN N ≥ K(H0 + C∗) − β − ϵ, log VN N ≥ KS∗ − ϵ. (52)
